caption: A running garden hose propped at an upward angle beside a vegetable bed sends its stream over the bed, and the water comes down on the far side.

sa.check: A running garden hose is propped at an upward angle beside a vegetable bed.
Its stream arcs over the bed.
The water comes down on the far side of the bed.
The hose is propped in place rather than held.
The bed lies between the hose and the spot where the water lands.

pc.expect: The stream leaves the nozzle along the hose's angle and curves over in one smooth arc.
pc.fail: The stream travels in a straight line to the far side; or it bends upward after leaving the nozzle; or it kinks or changes direction in mid-air.

pc.expect: The arc peaks and comes down, and the water lands on the far side and stays on the ground.
pc.fail: The water hangs in the air at the top of the arc; or it rises again after starting to fall; or it lands and rises back up.

pc.expect: The stream is a continuous jet that breaks into drops and spray as it falls, and the soil darkens and puddles where it lands.
pc.fail: The stream is a rigid rod that stays whole all the way to the ground; or it lands and the ground stays dry; or the water gathers into balls.

pc.expect: The hose stays propped and still and the arc of the stream stays steady.
pc.fail: The hose whips about with nothing touching it; or the stream jumps to a new arc; or the hose rises off its prop.

pc.expect: One hose and one stream: water appears only from the nozzle.
pc.fail: A second stream appears from nowhere; or the stream vanishes in mid-air; or the hose turns into another object.

pc.expect: The hose's colour, the bed's plants and the garden stay the same.
pc.fail: The hose changes colour; or the plants in the bed rearrange between frames; or the garden behind changes.
